events.title: Freddie Mercury tribute
events.blurb: Commemorating the 35th anniversary of Freddie Mercury's passing.

angles.name: A Kind of Magic
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, his stage presence, his sheer magic... still unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album "Rubber Soul" in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: A Turning Point
angles.copy: On this day in '65, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Widely seen as a pivotal moment, it changed everything for albums as an art form. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon tribute
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on the 46th anniversary of his death.

angles.name: Imagine The Legacy
angles.copy: 46 years today since the world lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Remembering David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. He was born on January 8, 1947.

angles.name: Starman's 80th
angles.copy: The legendary David Bowie would have turned 80 today. A true innovator who constantly reinvented himself. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering Elvis Presley on what would have been his 92nd birthday. He was born on January 8, 1935.

angles.name: The King's 92nd
angles.copy: The one and only King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, would have been 92 today. His impact on music is immeasurable.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday. He was born on January 9, 1944.

angles.name: Guitar God Turns 83
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page of Led Zeppelin. Responsible for some of the most iconic riffs in rock history.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Legendary singer Sir Rod Stewart celebrates his 82nd birthday. He was born on January 10, 1945.

angles.name: Forever Young at 82
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the iconic Rod Stewart! Still rocking and charming audiences worldwide. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Madness frontman Suggs (Graham McPherson) celebrates his 66th birthday. He was born on January 13, 1961.

angles.name: One Step Beyond 65
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs from Madness! Still bringing the house of fun wherever he goes.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Singer Paul Young celebrates his 71st birthday. He was born on January 17, 1956.

angles.name: No Parlez, Just Party
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! From 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' to 'Everytime You Go Away', his voice defined an era.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Country music icon Dolly Parton celebrates her 81st birthday. She was born on January 19, 1946.

angles.name: Jolene's 81st
angles.copy: The legendary Dolly Parton is 81 today! A true queen of country, music, and philanthropy. Here's to more years of sparkle.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday. He was born on January 20, 1971.

angles.name: Rule The World at 56
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow! A songwriting legend who's still got it.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Soul singer Billy Ocean celebrates his 77th birthday. He was born on January 21, 1950.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen at 77
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the smooth voice of Billy Ocean! "When the Going Gets Tough..." he's still making great music.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall Of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: The Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony on January 24, 1989.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its very first induction. Who do you think was in that inaugural class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday. He was born on January 27, 1972.

angles.name: Take That's Mark at 55
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Take That's Mark Owen! Still got that boyband charm.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the Apple Corps rooftop on January 30, 1969.

angles.name: Get Back to the Rooftop
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles played their last ever live performance on the Apple Corps rooftop. Imagine being there!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Genesis frontman and solo artist Phil Collins celebrates his 76th birthday. He was born on January 30, 1951.

angles.name: Against All Odds at 76
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! A true drumming and vocal icon. What's your favourite Phil track?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Pop superstar Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday. He was born on January 31, 1981.

angles.name: Bringing SexyBack at 46
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the one and only Justin Timberlake! From 'N Sync to solo stardom, he's done it all.

events.title: Sir David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary actor Sir David Jason celebrates his 87th birthday. He was born on February 2, 1940.

angles.name: Lovely Jubbly at 87
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the national treasure, Sir David Jason! What's your favourite Del Boy moment?

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Commemorating the tragic plane crash on February 3, 1959, that took the lives of Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper.

angles.name: Remembering The Legends
angles.copy: 68 years ago today, we lost Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper in a plane crash. The day the music died, but their songs live on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Singer Rick Astley celebrates his 61st birthday. He was born on February 6, 1966.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give You Up at 61
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the one and only Rick Astley! Still charming us all.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Remembering reggae legend Bob Marley on what would have been his 82nd birthday. He was born on February 6, 1945.

angles.name: One Love, 82 Years
angles.copy: The iconic Bob Marley would have been 82 today. His message of peace, love, and unity continues to resonate worldwide.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Singer-songwriter Carole King celebrates her 85th birthday. She was born on February 9, 1942.

angles.name: Tapestry of Hits at 85
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the legendary Carole King! A true songwriting genius whose music has touched generations.

events.title: Whitney Houston tribute
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic voice of Whitney Houston on the 15th anniversary of her passing.

angles.name: Remembering The Voice
angles.copy: 15 years today since we lost Whitney Houston, one of the greatest voices of all time. Her music lives on.

events.title: Take That split anniversary
events.blurb: Commemorating the day Take That originally announced their split on February 13, 1996.

angles.name: Back For Good, Eventually
angles.copy: Remember the day Take That broke millions of hearts? 31 years ago today, they announced their split. Thankfully, they came back for good!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: UB40 frontman Ali Campbell celebrates his 68th birthday. He was born on February 15, 1959.

angles.name: Red, Red Wine at 68
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the unmistakable voice of UB40! Still bringing the reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday. He was born on February 17, 1991.

angles.name: Perfectly 36
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! What's your favourite track from the Suffolk singer-songwriter?
